factorSources.note: The Infatuation (7.5, 'Good') highlights the prosciutto-and-cracked-egg and chicken pesto pies at this White Center spot; Seattle Times' The Ticket singles out the pepperoni slice, made with Zoe's Meats pepperoni.

The Infatuation rates Rocco's 6.8 ('It's Fine'), describing it mainly as a Belltown cocktail bar that turns out New York-style pies, with inconsistent slices and a red sauce that leans too heavily on oregano.

The Infatuation describes Talarico's as a casual West Seattle spot for big groups with slices 'bigger than your face'; Seattle Weekly calls it a pizza bar, not a pizzeria, known for oversized, heavily topped $4.95 slices and a sweet marinara best paired with spicy or salty toppings.

Seattle Times critic John Hinterberger praised the original Zeek's for its fresh-ingredient focus (dough made daily, herbs chopped twice daily, Danish-style whole-milk mozzarella), calling the Frog Belly Green 'a heck of a piece of pizza' despite too much garlic, and was surprised by the Thai-One-On.
Daily Hive's feature calls Pegasus Pizza 'a thing of beauty,' praising its generously portioned Greek-style pizza and large pasta plates served with soup or salad and garlic bread.
